title: #392 AI and Employment
prompt: What is your opinion on the role of artificial intelligence in shaping the future of employment? Do you see it as a threat or an opportunity for the workforce?

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.

modelPlan.focus: Explore the dual impact of AI on employment, balancing its potential as a tool for enhancing workforce capabilities with the challenges it poses regarding job displacement and the need for upskilling.
outline: Body 1: The Transformative Potential of AI in Employment
Body 2: Challenges and the Need for Adaptation
keyArguments: AI can augment human capabilities and create new job opportunities through human-machine collaboration.
The rise of AI necessitates upskilling and reskilling of the workforce to mitigate job displacement and adapt to technological changes.
